name: null_blk_alloc_dev
bug: null_alloc_dev() allocates the struct nullb_device with kzalloc() and frees it with kfree(dev) when badblocks_init() fails. Removing that call leaks the nullb_device: dev is a local variable that has not been published anywhere yet, and NULL is returned.
reachable: null_init() calls null_alloc_dev() at module load; when it returns NULL, init fails with -ENOMEM and the module is unloaded, so failing the allocation inside badblocks_init() with fail-nth leaves the object unreferenced.
reference: Models the class of early-exit leaks MLEE targets: a release on an error branch omitted by a code change.
